ALTER DATABASE noorserverless
COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8;

SELECT DATABASEPROPERTYEX('noorserverless', 'Collation') AS DatabaseCollation;

-- VIEWS

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS revenue_view;
CREATE VIEW revenue_view
AS
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    OPENROWSET
    (
        BULK 'raw_files',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
        FORMAT = 'CSV' ,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )
 AS Query1;
